props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root. The callback that fires when the state of the accordion changes.

props.name: type
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root. Required. 'single' keeps one section open at a time; 'multiple' lets several stay open. Use 'single' only when the workflow needs focused interaction.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root, only with type='single'. When true, the open section can be closed again. Without it, one section always stays open.

props.name: value
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root and Accordion.Item. On Accordion.Item it is required and names the section, unique within the accordion. On Accordion.Root it is the controlled open section: a string for type='single', a string array for type='multiple'.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root. The section or sections open on first render when the accordion is not controlled: a string for type='single', a string array for type='multiple'. Use it to set the default state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root (all sections) or Accordion.Item (one section). A disabled section cannot be opened or closed, so explain why in visible text.

props.name: variant
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root. The visual style of the sections. Use the default unless there is a reason not to.

values.name: default
values.whenToUse: The default. Use it unless there is a reason not to.

values.name: card
values.whenToUse: Not the default. Use it only when the default does not work; otherwise keep the default variant.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: Set on Accordion.Root. Which side of the trigger the expand indicator sits on. Prefer the right side; it is the default.

values.name: right
values.whenToUse: The default and the preferred position. Use it unless there is a reason not to.

values.name: left
values.whenToUse: Not the default. Use it only when the right side is not workable; otherwise keep the indicator on the right.
